feature_requests.title: NABIP Super Menu & Content Integration
feature_requests.description: Complete NABIP Website Integration with Mega-Menu Navigation
feature_requests.problem_statement: System needs to integrate all NABIP website content (74 distinct features across 9 sections) into unified platform. Currently separate systems create fragmented user experience. Need mega-menu navigation with full content hierarchy.
feature_requests.proposed_solution: Integrate complete NABIP content hierarchy across sections: Agent Finder, Who We Are, Membership, Professional Development, Advocacy, DEIB, Events, Member Resources, Chapter Resources, Newsroom. Implement mega-menu with multi-column layout, search within menu, breadcrumbs, responsive mobile design.
alternatives: Simple link integration (doesn't provide unified platform)
feature_requests.expected_impact: Medium-high priority, affects all members, estimated time: 8-10 weeks, consolidates all touchpoints
feature_requests.technical_considerations: Content migration from existing site, CMS for content management, search indexing across all content, permission system for restricted content, navigation analytics.

feature_requests.title: Committee & Volunteer Management
feature_requests.description: Complete Committee Management with Collaboration Tools
feature_requests.problem_statement: No system for managing committees, volunteers, or board members. Need tools for committee member portals, meeting scheduling, document collaboration, task tracking, volunteer hour logging, and board packet generation.
feature_requests.proposed_solution: Build comprehensive committee management: committee member portal with permissions, meeting scheduler with polls, document collaboration space, task assignment and tracking, volunteer hour logging with reports, application workflow, board packet generation.
alternatives: Using Google Workspace only (lacks committee-specific features)
feature_requests.expected_impact: Medium priority, affects committee members and admins, estimated time: 4-5 weeks, reduces coordination time by ~60%
feature_requests.technical_considerations: Real-time collaboration with WebSockets, document version control, notification system for assignments, calendar API integration, PDF generation for board packets.

sub_issues.title: Create Committee Member Portal
sub_issues.description: Build portal for committee members to access committee documents, calendar, tasks, and discussions. Apply role-based access so members only see their committees.

sub_issues.title: Add Meeting Scheduler with Polls
sub_issues.description: Tool for scheduling committee meetings. Send poll with date options, collect availability, auto-select best time, send calendar invites.

sub_issues.title: Implement Document Collaboration Space
sub_issues.description: Shared document workspace for committee with folders, file upload, version control, comments, and real-time editing for supported file types.

sub_issues.title: Build Task Assignment and Tracking
sub_issues.description: Create and assign tasks to committee members. Set due dates, priorities, descriptions. Track completion status and send reminders.

sub_issues.title: Add Volunteer Hour Logging
sub_issues.description: Allow committee members and volunteers to log hours worked. Include activity, date, hours, and description. Generate reports for leadership.

sub_issues.title: Create Committee Application Workflow
sub_issues.description: Application process for members wanting to join committees. Collect qualifications, submit application, route for approval, notify applicant of decision.

sub_issues.title: Implement Board Packet Generation
sub_issues.description: Auto-generate board packets by combining agenda, reports, financials, meeting minutes into single PDF. Email to board members before meetings.

feature_requests.title: Financial & Commerce Platform
feature_requests.description: Complete eCommerce System with Payment Processing
feature_requests.problem_statement: System lacks financial capabilities: no shopping cart for multiple purchases, no saved payment methods, no auto-renewal, basic promo codes, no gift memberships, limited invoice payment, no expense reimbursement.
feature_requests.proposed_solution: Build complete eCommerce platform: shopping cart for bundled purchases, secure payment vault for saved methods, auto-renewal configuration, flexible payment plans, enhanced promo code system, gift membership purchasing, invoice payment portal, expense reimbursement workflow.
alternatives: Using Stripe Customer Portal only (limited customization)
feature_requests.expected_impact: Medium-high priority, affects all paying members and finance team, estimated time: 5-6 weeks, reduces payment processing time by ~70%
feature_requests.technical_considerations: Payment gateway (Stripe, Square, Authorize.net), PCI compliance, fraud detection, recurring billing engine, refund and chargeback handling.

sub_issues.title: Implement Shopping Cart
sub_issues.description: Build shopping cart allowing members to add multiple items (membership, events, courses) and checkout once. Show subtotal, taxes, discounts in cart.

sub_issues.title: Add Saved Payment Methods Vault
sub_issues.description: Securely store payment methods (credit cards, bank accounts) for future use. PCI compliant tokenization. Allow adding/removing payment methods.

sub_issues.title: Create Auto-Renewal Setup
sub_issues.description: Allow members to enable auto-renewal for memberships. Send notification before renewal, charge saved payment method, email receipt, handle failures gracefully.

sub_issues.title: Build Payment Plan Configuration
sub_issues.description: Offer payment plans for expensive items. Configure number of payments, frequency, down payment. Auto-charge on schedule and track payment status.

sub_issues.title: Enhance Promo Code System
sub_issues.description: Advanced promo code system with rules: percentage off, dollar off, free shipping, expiration dates, usage limits, member restrictions, minimum purchase.

sub_issues.title: Add Gift Membership Purchasing
sub_issues.description: Allow purchasing membership as gift for someone else. Collect recipient info, send gift notification email, set start date, and allow recipient to activate.

sub_issues.title: Create Invoice Payment Portal
sub_issues.description: Portal for members with invoices to view outstanding invoices, pay online, download receipts, set up payment plans, and view payment history.

sub_issues.title: Implement Expense Reimbursement System
sub_issues.description: System for members to submit expense reports for approval and reimbursement. Upload receipts, categorize expenses, route for approval, track reimbursement status.
